summary: This short note concerns Lemma Barkaloo, whose name is attached to a named professorship at the Washington University school of law. It records that Susan Frelich Appleton was installed as the inaugural holder of the Lemma Barkeloo and Phoebe Couzins Professor of Law in 2000. The note is brief and gives no biographical detail about Barkaloo herself.
one_line: Lemma Barkaloo is honored in the Lemma Barkeloo and Phoebe Couzins Professorship of Law at Washington University's law school.
key_facts: In 2000, Susan Frelich Appleton, J.D., was installed as the inaugural Lemma Barkeloo and Phoebe Couzins Professor of Law.
The professorship is held at the Washington University school of law.
The named professorship honors Lemma Barkeloo and Phoebe Couzins.
Susan Frelich Appleton was the first holder of the Lemma Barkeloo and Phoebe Couzins Professor of Law chair.
The note spells the name as 'Lemma Barkeloo' in the professorship title and 'Lemma Barkaloo' in the page title.
